CustomField.inlineHelpText: LEAVE BLANK unless this table's rows come from an autolaunched Flow. API name of that Flow. It takes a Quote_Document_Row__c collection named rows plus Text inputs quoteId, tableCode, locale, currencyIsoCode, and must return a collection named rows. IMPORTANT: a Flow loop variable is a COPY - collect edited rows into a second collection and assign that back to rows, or your edits are silently discarded. Runs AFTER the Apex customizer and can overwrite it.
CustomField.label: Row Customizer Flow
